Test Scenario / Title: Verify user can log in with valid email and password
Test Steps:
1. Open the Login page.
2. Enter a valid email address.
3. Enter a valid password.
4. Click Login.
Expected Result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to the Home page.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify login with an invalid password
Test Steps:
1. Open Login page.
2. Enter a valid email.
3. Enter an invalid password.
4. Click Login.
Expected Result: Error message "Invalid email or password" is displayed.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify user can log out successfully
Test Steps:
1. Click Profile.
2. Click Logout.
Expected Result: User is logged out and redirected to the Login page.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify login with an unregistered email
Test Steps:
1. Open Login page.
2. Enter an unregistered email.
3. Enter any password.
4. Click Login.
Expected Result: User cannot log in and an appropriate error message is displayed.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify login fails with incorrect password
Test Steps:
1. Enter a valid email.
2. Enter an incorrect password.
3. Click Login multiple times.
Expected Result: Login is rejected each time and the account is handled per the lockout/error policy.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify user can logout successfully
Test Steps:
1. Click Profile menu.
2. Click Logout.
Expected Result: User session ends and user is redirected to the Login page.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify Forgot Password page opens
Test Steps: 1. Click Forgot Password link on Login page.
Expected Result: Forgot Password page is displayed.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify password reset email is sent
Test Steps:
1. Open Forgot Password.
2. Enter registered email.
3. Click Submit.
Expected Result: Password reset email is sent successfully to the registered address.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify user session remains active after login
Test Steps:
1. Log in successfully.
2. Navigate across pages without logging out.
Expected Result: User session remains active and user is not logged out unexpectedly.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify user can register with valid details
Test Steps:
1. Open Registration page.
2. Fill all mandatory fields with valid data.
3. Click Register.
Expected Result: Account is created successfully.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify mandatory fields during registration
Test Steps:
1. Open Registration page.
2. Leave required fields empty.
3. Click Register.
Expected Result: Required field validation messages are displayed.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify valid email format is accepted
Test Steps:
1. Enter a valid email.
2. Submit registration.
Expected Result: Email is accepted and registration proceeds.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify invalid email format is rejected
Test Steps:
1. Enter an invalid email format.
2. Submit registration.
Expected Result: Validation message is displayed and registration is blocked.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify strong password is accepted
Test Steps:
1. Enter a strong password.
2. Submit registration.
Expected Result: Registration proceeds successfully.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify weak password is rejected
Test Steps:
1. Enter a weak password.
2. Submit registration.
Expected Result: Password strength validation message is displayed.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify Terms & Conditions are mandatory
Test Steps:
1. Fill registration form.
2. Do not check Terms & Conditions.
3. Click Register.
Expected Result: Registration is blocked and validation message is displayed.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify account verification email is sent
Test Steps: 1. Complete registration with valid details.
Expected Result: Verification email is sent to the registered email address.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify book ratings are displayed correctly

Test Scenario / Title: Verify customer reviews are displayed

Test Steps:

Test Scenario / Title: Verify cart count updates after adding a book
Preconditions: User is logged in. Book is in stock.
Test Steps:
1. Open book details.
2. Click Add to Cart.
Expected Result: Selected book is added to the cart and cart count is updated.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify user can increase book quantity in the cart
Preconditions: At least one book is added to the cart.
Test Steps:
1. Open the shopping cart.
2. Increase the quantity of the book.
Expected Result: Book quantity is updated and total price is recalculated.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify user can decrease book quantity in the cart
Preconditions: Cart contains multiple quantities of the same book.
Test Steps:
1. Open the shopping cart.
2. Reduce the quantity of the book.
Expected Result: Quantity decreases and total amount updates correctly.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify user can remove a book from the cart
Preconditions: Cart contains at least one book.
Test Steps:
1. Open the shopping cart.
2. Click Remove for a book.
Expected Result: Selected book is removed from the cart.

Test Scenario / Title: The selected book is removed successfully from the cart.
Preconditions: Cart contains at least one book.
Test Steps:
1. Click Remove on the target book.
2. Confirm removal if prompted.
Expected Result: The selected book is removed successfully and cart total updates.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify user can move a book to the Save for Later list
Test Steps:
1. Open the shopping cart.
2. Click Save for Later on a book.
Expected Result: Book is moved from the cart to the Save for Later list.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify user can add a valid shipping address
Test Steps:
1. Proceed to Checkout.
2. Enter a valid shipping address.
3. Save the address.
Expected Result: Shipping address is saved successfully.

Test Scenario / Title: Shipping address is saved successfully. User proceeds to the next checkout step.
Preconditions: User is on the shipping address step.
Test Steps:
1. Enter valid shipping details.
2. Click Save & Continue.
Expected Result: Shipping address is saved successfully and user proceeds to the next checkout step.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify billing address can be same as shipping address
Test Steps:
1. Select "Billing address same as shipping".
2. Click Continue.
Expected Result: Shipping address is automatically used as the billing address.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify successful payment using valid card details
Preconditions: User is on the payment page.
Test Steps:
1. Enter valid card details.
2. Click Pay Now.
Expected Result: Payment is processed successfully.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify payment is declined with invalid card details
Preconditions: User is on the payment page.
Test Steps:
1. Enter invalid card details.
2. Click Pay Now.
Expected Result: Payment is declined and an appropriate error message is displayed.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify order summary before placing an order
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to the Order Review page.
Expected Result: Order summary displays correct products, quantities, shipping charges and total amount.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify user can place an order successfully
Test Steps:
1. Review order summary.
2. Click Place Order.
Expected Result: Order is placed successfully and confirmation page is displayed.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify order confirmation page displays Order ID
Test Steps: 1. Complete checkout.
Expected Result: Order confirmation page is displayed with a unique Order ID.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify order summary after successful purchase
Test Steps: 1. Review the order summary on the confirmation page.
Expected Result: Ordered items, quantities, prices and total amount are accurate.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify confirmation email is sent after order placement
Test Steps: 1. Check the registered email inbox.
Expected Result: Order confirmation email is received with correct order details.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify invoice is generated after successful purchase
Test Steps:
1. Open the order details page.
2. View or download the invoice.
Expected Result: Invoice is generated successfully with correct order information.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify Continue Shopping button functionality
Test Steps: 1. Click Continue Shopping.
Expected Result: User is redirected to the Book Catalog/Home page and can continue browsing books.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify order status is displayed after purchase
Test Steps: 1. Open Order History/Order Details.
Expected Result: Correct order status (e.g., Processing/Confirmed) is displayed.

Test Scenario / Title: Verify user can reorder previously purchased books
Preconditions: User has at least one previous order.
Test Steps:
1. Open Order History.
2. Select a past order.
3. Click Reorder.
